text: I spent $38 on a used mechanical keyboard and got about $38 worth of keyboard, maybe a little more. Let me start with the flaws. The spacebar rattles, not a gentle click, a hollow loose clatter every time my thumb hits it, like you push a tray of cutlery. I stopped noticing it during the day but at night it sounds louder than it has any right to. The E key also repeats itself sometimes, so meeting becomes meeeeting. Happens maybe once every few paragraphs. So it's just often enough to make me proofread. Communication with the seller was slow. I asked what switches it was before buying, got a reply a week later. It was brown switches. Still, the surprise is that it's actually comfortable to type on. Cushioned feeling, I can write long emails without my wrists complaining. Which is more than I can say for the flat laptop keyboard I had. I thought about returning it but the hassle didn't seem worth it. So it stays on my desk. It rattles, repeats, and quietly earns its keep. Three stars.
